title: UCSB XRP API reference
introduction: Each call to Robot.step() performs one control-loop update: it converts a MotionCommand into WheelSpeeds and a DriveCommand, reads the robot sensors, updates Measurements and Pose, and returns a RobotState. Six recurring component classes perform sensor interpretation, wheel-speed control, differential-drive kinematics, odometry, navigation, and path planning. Three extension components address range-constrained stopping, known-wall position correction, and bounded multi-stop ordering. The class you implement in each named project file may use any algorithm that satisfies the required behavior stated here.
conventions: Distances, positions, wheel travel, and range use millimeters (mm).
Linear and wheel speeds use millimeters per second (mm/s). Device timestamps use integer milliseconds; calculated elapsed time uses seconds.
Angles use radians and turn rates use radians per second. Positive heading and turn rate are counterclockwise.
A DriveCommand is dimensionless and each wheel command is within -1.0 to 1.0.
World +x is the reference forward direction and world +y points left. Positive wheel speed means forward wheel motion.

sections.title: Classes you implement
sections.introduction: You implement each class in its named project file. Inherit the listed base class without changing its public methods. Robot and DeliveryMission call the appropriate methods, so the rest of the project does not change when course_setup.py selects the class from that project file.

entries.name: SensorModel
entries.purpose: Convert encoder counts and device time into wheel positions, wheel-travel increments, regularized wheel-speed estimates, and elapsed sample time while preserving ultrasonic range and USER-button state. Robot calls reset() once at the start of a run and update() after each hardware sample; estimate_range() combines repeated ultrasonic readings.
entries.state: After reset(), retain the encoder and time zero values, the preceding sample, and enough recent encoder history to estimate wheel speed. Wheel position remains relative to the reset values.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Robot sampling, encoder, wheel, and wheel-speed-estimation settings. The same value is available inside the class as self.config.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not a RobotConfig value.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Establish the encoder and time origins for a new run.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: First hardware sample after Robot resets the encoders.

returns.description: A measurement at raw.time_ms with zero positions, increments, speeds, and dt_s, while preserving raw.range_mm and raw.button_pressed.

exceptions: TypeError if raw is not a RawSensors value.
requiredBehavior: Prepare update() to process the next chronological sample.
Reset all wheel-speed estimator history so the first reported speeds are zero.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Convert the next hardware sample into physical measurements.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Next encoder, device-time, range, and USER-button sample.

returns.description: Cumulative wheel positions from the reset values, the latest unsmoothed wheel increments, wheel-speed estimates from recent encoder samples, elapsed time, range, and button state.

exceptions: RuntimeError if reset() has not been called.
TypeError if raw is not a RawSensors value.
requiredBehavior: Apply the configured encoder signs, wheel diameter, and encoder counts per revolution.
Calculate dt_s from consecutive device timestamps with elapsed_time_s().
Do not smooth left_increment_mm or right_increment_mm; odometry uses the measured increments.
Estimate wheel speed from recent encoder samples or an equivalent estimator whose response is set by wheel_speed_filter_time_constant_ms. The exact estimator algorithm is not prescribed.
If no positive time has elapsed, report dt_s as zero without dividing by zero; positions and increments still follow the new encoder counts.
Preserve raw.range_mm and raw.button_pressed in the returned Measurements.

methods.name: estimate_range
methods.summary: Combine repeated ultrasonic readings while rejecting unusable values.

parameters.name: minimum_usable
parameters.description: Minimum number of usable readings required; must be at least 1.

returns.description: Median of the finite, positive, non-Boolean readings, or None when too few usable readings remain.

exceptions: TypeError if minimum_usable is not an integer or samples cannot be iterated.
ValueError if minimum_usable is less than 1.

example.title: Measure one encoder update
example.code:
from robot_config import ROBOT_CONFIG
from sensor_model import SensorModel
from ucsb_xrp import RawSensors

model = SensorModel(ROBOT_CONFIG)
model.reset(RawSensors(0, 0, 0, None, False))
measurement = model.update(RawSensors(20, 4, 5, None, False))
print(measurement.left_increment_mm)
print(measurement.left_speed_mm_s)

entries.name: WheelSpeedController
entries.purpose: Calculate one bounded motor command for each wheel from its requested speed and measured speed. Robot calls reset() at the start of a run and update() during each Robot.step() call.
entries.state: The controller may retain values needed from earlier samples. reset() must return all retained controller values to their initial condition.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Motor calibration, feedback gain, and command limit. The same value is available inside the class as self.config.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not a RobotConfig value.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Prepare controller state for a new run.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Calculate the next motor command for both wheels.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Requested left and right wheel speeds from DifferentialDrive.

parameters.name: measured
parameters.description: Latest wheel-speed estimates formed from recent encoder samples by SensorModel.

returns.description: Normalized left and right motor commands bounded by config.max_drive_command.

exceptions: TypeError if target or measured is not a WheelSpeeds value.
requiredBehavior: Return an exact zero command for a wheel whose requested speed is zero.
Keep each command within plus or minus config.max_drive_command.

For a nonzero requested speed, increasing the speed error in the requested direction must not weaken the command. Before the command reaches config.max_drive_command, the larger speed error must produce a stronger command under the same conditions.

entries.name: DifferentialDrive
entries.purpose: Convert a requested robot forward speed and turn rate into the two wheel-speed targets required by a differential-drive robot. Robot calls wheel_speeds() during each Robot.step() call.
entries.state: None. Each wheel_speeds() calculation depends only on its MotionCommand and the configured track width.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Robot geometry containing the effective track width. The same value is available inside the class as self.config.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not a RobotConfig value.

methods.name: wheel_speeds
methods.summary: Calculate target wheel speeds for one body-motion request.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Requested forward speed and counterclockwise turn rate.

returns.description: Target left and right wheel speeds in mm/s.

exceptions: TypeError if command is not a MotionCommand value.
requiredBehavior: Produce wheel speeds consistent with planar differential-drive kinematics and config.track_width_mm.
Zero turn rate produces equal wheel speeds. Positive turn rate produces a greater right-wheel speed than left-wheel speed; negative turn rate reverses that relationship.
Support straight motion, in-place rotation, and simultaneous forward motion and turning.

entries.name: Odometry
entries.purpose: Estimate the robot's world position and heading from measured left- and right-wheel travel. Robot establishes the initial Pose with reset() and supplies one pair of wheel increments to update() after each sample.
entries.state: After reset(), retain the latest Pose. The estimate uses measured wheel travel only; simulator ground truth is not an input.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Robot geometry containing the effective track width. The same value is available inside the class as self.config.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not a RobotConfig value.

properties.name: pose
properties.description: Latest estimated pose; available after reset().

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Set the pose for a new run.
exceptions: TypeError if initial_pose is not a Pose value.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Integrate one differential-drive wheel-travel increment.

parameters.name: left_increment_mm
parameters.description: Signed left-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

parameters.name: right_increment_mm
parameters.description: Signed right-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

returns.description: Updated pose with heading wrapped to [-pi, pi).

exceptions: RuntimeError if reset() has not been called.
TypeError for Boolean or nonnumeric increments.
requiredBehavior: Equal wheel increments translate the pose without changing its heading. Equal and opposite increments rotate the pose about the midpoint between the wheels.
Unequal increments follow the exact constant-curvature arc implied by the two wheel paths; do not replace a finite turn with a straight-line approximation.
Wrap the updated heading to [-pi, pi), retain the new Pose, and return it.

entries.name: NavigationController
entries.purpose: Generate forward-speed and turn-rate commands that visit an ordered sequence of world-coordinate goals. The course program supplies the latest odometry Pose and sends each returned MotionCommand to Robot.
entries.state: Retain the ordered goals, the active goal, completion state, and any turning, driving, or final-alignment state used by the implementation.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Travel speeds, turn rate, slowdown distance, and position and heading tolerances. The same value is available inside the class as self.config.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not a NavigationConfig value.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Store an ordered goal sequence and begin navigation.

parameters.name: goals
parameters.description: Tuple or list of navigation goals in visit order; it may be empty.

requiredBehavior: An empty goal sequence is immediately complete; current_goal() returns None and update() returns STOP_COMMAND.
exceptions: TypeError if goals is not a tuple or list or contains a value other than NavigationGoal.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Calculate the next motion request from the latest odometry pose.

returns.description: Forward-speed and turn-rate request for the next Robot step.

requiredBehavior: Use wrap-safe heading errors.
Turn toward a goal before driving forward when the heading error is large.
Use approach speed within config.slowdown_distance_mm of the goal and realign if the heading error grows beyond config.realign_heading_rad.
Visit goals in their supplied order. A goal with heading_rad=None requires position only; a numerical final heading must also be reached.
After all goals are complete, return STOP_COMMAND.
exceptions: TypeError if pose is not a Pose value.

methods.name: current_goal
methods.summary: Return the active goal, or None after completion.

methods.name: is_complete
methods.summary: Report whether every required position and heading is complete.

returns.description: True only after the complete goal sequence has been reached.

entries.name: GridPlanner
entries.purpose: Find a connected route through free cells in an occupancy grid. Course planning code or DeliveryMission calls plan() and converts the returned GridPath into navigation goals.
entries.state: None is required between calls. Search data may remain local to one plan() calculation.

methods.name: plan
methods.signature: plan(grid: OccupancyGrid, start: GridCell | None, goal: GridCell | None) -> GridPath | None
methods.summary: Find a valid connected route from the start cell to the goal cell.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description: Map of free and blocked cells.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Starting cell, or None when the position lies outside the grid.

parameters.name: goal
parameters.description: Destination cell, or None when the position lies outside the grid.

returns.description: A route including both endpoints, or None when an endpoint is unavailable or blocked or no route exists.

requiredBehavior: Use only free cells and move between cells that share a horizontal or vertical edge.
Any route that connects the endpoints through free edge-adjacent cells is accepted.
exceptions: TypeError if grid is not OccupancyGrid or a non-None endpoint is not GridCell.

sections.title: Challenge-specific extension components
sections.introduction: These focused components are introduced in Challenges 6–8 and then carried forward. Each named project class and supplied reference class has the same constructor and public methods; course_setup.py selects between them with the corresponding USE_STUDENT_* Boolean.

entries.name: RangeSafetyController
entries.purpose: Limit a nonnegative forward-speed request using measured forward speed and available forward range.
entries.state: Retain the configured response time, minimum deceleration, stopping margin, and maximum speed.

methods.name: update
methods.signature: update(requested_speed_mm_s: float, measured_speed_mm_s: float, range_mm: float | None) -> float
methods.summary: Return a forward-speed request that preserves the configured stopping margin.

parameters.name: range_mm
parameters.description: Filtered forward range, or None when unavailable.

returns.description: A nonnegative request no greater than the nominal request or configured maximum.

requiredBehavior: Return zero when range is unavailable or the configured stopping margin cannot be preserved.
Include the configured response interval and minimum deceleration when deciding whether continued motion is admissible.
Do not command reverse motion as part of this component.

notes: The project class inherits RangeSafetyControllerBase, which validates and stores the four constructor settings.

entries.name: PoseCorrector
entries.purpose: Retain a planar translation from raw odometry coordinates into a map frame. Known-wall observations correct one position coordinate at a time; heading remains the raw odometry heading.
entries.state: After reset(), retain independent x and y translation corrections.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Clear prior translation corrections and establish the initial corrected pose.

returns.description: Initial corrected pose with the raw heading preserved.

methods.name: observe_x
methods.signature: observe_x(raw_pose: Pose, range_mm: float, wall_x_mm: float, facing_positive_x: bool) -> Pose
methods.summary: Use a known x-normal wall observation to update only the x correction.

returns.description: Corrected pose with the inferred x coordinate.

requiredBehavior: Infer x from the known wall coordinate, sensor offset, range, and facing direction without changing the retained y correction.

methods.name: observe_y
methods.signature: observe_y(raw_pose: Pose, range_mm: float, wall_y_mm: float, facing_positive_y: bool) -> Pose
methods.summary: Use a known y-normal wall observation to update only the y correction.

returns.description: Corrected pose with the inferred y coordinate.

requiredBehavior: Infer y from the known wall coordinate, sensor offset, range, and facing direction without changing the retained x correction.

methods.name: corrected_pose
methods.summary: Apply the retained translation to a raw odometry pose.
requiredBehavior: reset() must have been called before this method.

notes: The project class inherits PoseCorrectorBase, which validates and stores sensor_forward_offset_mm.

entries.name: VisitOrderPlanner
entries.purpose: Choose a least-cost order for a bounded set of required service stops.

methods.name: plan
methods.signature: plan(cost_table, start_index: int, required_indices: sequence[int], finish_index: int) -> tuple[int, ...] | None
methods.summary: Return the least-cost complete visit order.

parameters.name: cost_table
parameters.description: Square pairwise route-cost table; None marks an unavailable directed connection.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: First node in the returned order.

parameters.name: required_indices
parameters.description: Distinct stops to visit exactly once.

parameters.name: finish_index
parameters.description: Final node; it may equal start_index.

returns.description: Start, every required stop exactly once, and finish in least-cost order, or None when no complete order is reachable.

requiredBehavior: Sum only available pairwise costs along a candidate order.
Break equal-cost ties by lexicographic tuple order.
Reject duplicate required stops and indices outside the table.

sections.title: Robot services
sections.introduction: Use Robot for ordinary course programs. It assembles the selected components and performs the timed sequence of motor commands, sensor readings, measurements, and odometry in each Robot.step() call.

entries.name: Robot
entries.purpose: Perform one robot control-loop update: convert the requested body motion to wheel targets, update motor commands, read sensors, update odometry, and publish telemetry. Course projects normally obtain Robot from make_robot(ROBOT_CONFIG).
entries.state: After start(), retain the selected classes, latest RobotState, next absolute sample time, and latest timing overrun.
entries.signature: Robot(config, bot, sensor_model, wheel_controller, differential_drive, odometry)

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Timing, geometry, calibration, gains, and limits.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not RobotConfig or a supplied object does not provide the methods required by Robot.

properties.name: config
properties.description: Robot configuration supplied at construction.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Latest state; raises RuntimeError before start().

properties.name: last_overrun_ms
properties.description: Amount by which the latest calculation exceeded its sample deadline, or zero.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Reset encoders and components and begin a run.
requiredBehavior: An IDE-managed Run begins immediately. A project launched directly on the XRP waits for the USER button.
exceptions: TypeError if initial_pose is not a Pose value.
Hardware or component exceptions raised while resetting or taking the initial sample.

methods.name: step
methods.signature: step(command: MotionCommand, read_range: bool = False) -> RobotState
methods.summary: Execute one complete robot control cycle.

parameters.name: read_range
parameters.description: Request an ultrasonic reading for this sample.

requiredBehavior: Stops the motors before re-raising an exception from the cycle.
Maintains the configured absolute sample schedule; do not add sleep_ms() inside the control loop.
exceptions: RuntimeError if start() has not been called.
TypeError if command is not MotionCommand or read_range is not Boolean.
Hardware or component exceptions raised during the sample; Robot attempts to stop the motors before re-raising them.

methods.name: estimate_range
methods.summary: Use the selected SensorModel to combine range readings.

parameters.name: minimum_usable
parameters.description: Minimum number of usable readings required.

returns.description: Range estimate in mm, or None.

exceptions: TypeError if samples cannot be iterated, an element is not a number or None, or minimum_usable is not an integer. This catches program values such as a string before they can be mistaken for a missing sensor reading.
ValueError if minimum_usable is less than 1.
Exceptions raised by the selected SensorModel after input validation.

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Stop both motors and publish a zero drive command.
exceptions: Hardware exception if the motors cannot be stopped.

entries.name: StraightLineController
entries.purpose: Generate a straight-ahead MotionCommand from measured mean wheel travel, using cruise speed far from the target, approach speed near it, and zero speed at completion.
entries.state: After start(), retain the initial mean wheel position, requested travel distance, and completion state.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Cruise and approach speeds, slowdown distance, and position tolerance.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not a NavigationConfig value.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Begin a nonnegative forward move from the current mean wheel position.

parameters.name: measurements
parameters.description: Measurements at the beginning of the move.

exceptions: TypeError if measurements is not a Measurements value.
ValueError if distance_mm is Boolean, nonnumeric, nonfinite, or negative.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Return cruise, approach, or stop command from remaining distance.
exceptions: RuntimeError if start() has not been called.
TypeError if measurements is not a Measurements value.

methods.name: is_complete
methods.summary: Report whether the distance is within the position tolerance.

sections.title: Data types
sections.introduction: These read-only records store sensor readings, motion requests, controller outputs, pose, and planning data passed between UCSBXRP classes.

entries.name: RawSensors
entries.purpose: Store one direct hardware sample.

properties.name: time_ms
properties.description: Device timestamp.

properties.name: left_encoder_count
properties.description: Left encoder count relative to the latest reset.

properties.name: right_encoder_count
properties.description: Right encoder count relative to the latest reset.

properties.name: range_mm
properties.description: Ultrasonic range, or None when unavailable or not requested.

properties.name: button_pressed
properties.description: Current USER-button state.

exceptions: TypeError if time_ms or an encoder count is not an integer, button_pressed is not Boolean, or range_mm is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if time_ms is negative or range_mm is nonfinite or not greater than zero.

entries.name: Measurements
entries.purpose: Store sensor-derived motion and range values for one sample.
entries.signature: Measurements(time_ms, dt_s, left_position_mm, right_position_mm, left_increment_mm, right_increment_mm, left_speed_mm_s, right_speed_mm_s, range_mm, button_pressed)

properties.name: time_ms
properties.description: Device timestamp.

properties.name: dt_s
properties.description: Elapsed time from the preceding sample.

properties.name: left_position_mm
properties.description: Cumulative left-wheel travel since reset.

properties.name: right_position_mm
properties.description: Cumulative right-wheel travel since reset.

properties.name: left_increment_mm
properties.description: Unsmoothed left-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

properties.name: right_increment_mm
properties.description: Unsmoothed right-wheel travel since the preceding sample.

properties.name: left_speed_mm_s
properties.description: Left-wheel speed estimate formed from recent encoder samples.

properties.name: right_speed_mm_s
properties.description: Right-wheel speed estimate formed from recent encoder samples.

properties.name: range_mm
properties.description: Range reading or None.

properties.name: button_pressed
properties.description: USER-button state.

properties.name: wheel_speeds
properties.description: Left and right speed estimates as one value.

exceptions: TypeError if a numeric argument is Boolean or nonnumeric, time_ms is not an integer, or button_pressed is not Boolean.
ValueError if time_ms or dt_s is negative, a number is nonfinite, or a supplied range is not greater than zero.

entries.name: WheelSpeeds
entries.purpose: Store left and right wheel speeds.

properties.name: left_mm_s
properties.description: Left-wheel speed.

properties.name: right_mm_s
properties.description: Right-wheel speed.

exceptions: TypeError if either wheel speed is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if either wheel speed is not finite.

entries.name: MotionCommand
entries.purpose: Store requested robot-body motion.

properties.name: forward_speed_mm_s
properties.description: Requested forward speed.

properties.name: turn_rate_rad_s
properties.description: Requested counterclockwise turn rate.

exceptions: TypeError if either argument is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if either argument is not finite.

entries.name: DriveCommand
entries.purpose: Store normalized left and right motor commands before hardware sign conversion.

properties.name: left
properties.description: Left command in [-1.0, 1.0].

properties.name: right
properties.description: Right command in [-1.0, 1.0].

exceptions: TypeError if either command is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if either command is nonfinite or outside [-1.0, 1.0].
notes: MotorEfforts is a compatibility name for the same type. Use DriveCommand in new code.

entries.name: Pose
entries.purpose: Store estimated position and heading in world coordinates.

properties.name: x_mm
properties.description: World x position.

properties.name: y_mm
properties.description: World y position.

properties.name: heading_rad
properties.description: Heading wrapped to [-pi, pi).

exceptions: TypeError if a coordinate or heading is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate or heading is not finite.

entries.name: RobotState
entries.purpose: Pair the measurements and odometry pose returned by one robot sample.

properties.name: measurements
properties.description: Sensor-derived values.

properties.name: pose
properties.description: Odometry estimate.

exceptions: TypeError if measurements is not Measurements or pose is not Pose.

entries.name: NavigationGoal
entries.purpose: Store a destination position and optional required heading.

properties.name: x_mm
properties.description: Destination x position.

properties.name: y_mm
properties.description: Destination y position.

properties.name: heading_rad
properties.description: Required final heading, or None for position only.

exceptions: TypeError if a coordinate or supplied heading is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate or supplied heading is not finite.

entries.name: GridCell
entries.purpose: Store one integer occupancy-grid coordinate.

properties.name: column
properties.description: Column increasing with world x.

properties.name: row
properties.description: Row increasing with world y.

exceptions: TypeError if column or row is not an integer.

entries.name: GridPath
entries.purpose: Store an ordered route of edge-adjacent grid cells.

properties.name: cells
properties.description: Nonempty route of horizontally or vertically adjacent cells.

exceptions: TypeError if cells is not a tuple or list or contains a value other than GridCell.
ValueError if cells is empty or consecutive cells do not share a horizontal or vertical edge.

methods.name: to_goals
methods.signature: to_goals(grid: OccupancyGrid, final_heading_rad: float | None = None) -> tuple[NavigationGoal, ...]
methods.summary: Convert the route to compact goals at turns and the final cell.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description: Grid used to convert cell centers to world coordinates.

parameters.name: final_heading_rad
parameters.description: Optional heading required at the final goal.

exceptions: AttributeError if grid does not provide cell_center().
TypeError if final_heading_rad is Boolean or nonnumeric, or grid.cell_center() rejects a path cell's type.
ValueError if final_heading_rad is not finite or grid.cell_center() rejects a cell outside the grid.

entries.name: STOP_COMMAND
entries.purpose: Shared zero-motion request.

sections.title: Configuration
sections.introduction: Robot settings belong in robot_config.py. Each configuration object is read-only after construction.

entries.name: RobotConfig
entries.purpose: Define one robot's sample timing, wheel geometry, wiring directions, motor calibration, wheel-speed-estimator response, feedback gain, and motor-command limit.
entries.signature: RobotConfig(sample_period_ms=20, wheel_diameter_mm=60.0, encoder_counts_per_revolution=585.0, track_width_mm=155.0, left_motor_sign=1, right_motor_sign=1, left_encoder_sign=1, right_encoder_sign=1, left_start_command=0.0, right_start_command=0.0, left_speed_command_gain=0.0, right_speed_command_gain=0.0, wheel_speed_filter_time_constant_ms=80.0, wheel_speed_kp=0.0, max_drive_command=1.0)

properties.name: sample_period_ms
properties.description: Scheduled interval between Robot samples; integer at least 1.

properties.name: wheel_diameter_mm
properties.description: Measured wheel diameter used to convert encoder revolutions to wheel travel; greater than zero.

properties.name: encoder_counts_per_revolution
properties.description: Encoder counts corresponding to one wheel revolution; greater than zero.

properties.name: track_width_mm
properties.description: Effective lateral distance between the left and right wheel paths, used by DifferentialDrive and Odometry; greater than zero.

properties.name: left_motor_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1, chosen so a positive left DriveCommand turns the left wheel forward.

properties.name: right_motor_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1, chosen so a positive right DriveCommand turns the right wheel forward.

properties.name: left_encoder_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1, chosen so forward left-wheel travel produces a positive count change.

properties.name: right_encoder_sign
properties.description: +1 or -1, chosen so forward right-wheel travel produces a positive count change.

properties.name: left_start_command
properties.description: Nonnegative left-wheel command needed to overcome motor deadband when a nonzero speed is requested.

properties.name: right_start_command
properties.description: Nonnegative right-wheel command needed to overcome motor deadband when a nonzero speed is requested.

properties.name: left_speed_command_gain
properties.description: Left-wheel feedforward command per unit of requested wheel speed.

properties.name: right_speed_command_gain
properties.description: Right-wheel feedforward command per unit of requested wheel speed.

properties.name: wheel_speed_filter_time_constant_ms
properties.description: Additional response time of the wheel-speed estimate formed from recent encoder samples; zero selects the estimator's minimum supported response.

properties.name: wheel_speed_kp
properties.description: Proportional change in motor command per unit of wheel-speed error.

properties.name: max_drive_command
properties.description: Maximum absolute DriveCommand sent to either motor; from 0.0 to 1.0 inclusive.

exceptions: TypeError if an argument has the wrong type, an unknown argument is supplied, or a current and older compatibility name are both supplied.
ValueError if a number is not finite or violates the range stated above, or if a starting command exceeds max_drive_command.
notes: For compatibility with projects created before API 0.3, the implementation also accepts the older argument names ending in _effort. New projects should use the names above.

entries.name: NavigationConfig
entries.purpose: Define the travel speeds, slowdown distance, turn rate, and accepted position and heading errors used by StraightLineController and NavigationController.
entries.signature: NavigationConfig(cruise_speed_mm_s, approach_speed_mm_s, slowdown_distance_mm, turn_rate_rad_s, position_tolerance_mm, heading_tolerance_rad, realign_heading_rad)

properties.name: cruise_speed_mm_s
properties.description: Normal forward speed away from a goal; greater than zero.

properties.name: approach_speed_mm_s
properties.description: Reduced forward speed near a goal; greater than zero and no greater than cruise_speed_mm_s.

properties.name: slowdown_distance_mm
properties.description: Remaining distance at which the controller changes from cruise speed to approach speed; greater than zero.

properties.name: turn_rate_rad_s
properties.description: Magnitude of the requested angular velocity while turning; greater than zero.

properties.name: position_tolerance_mm
properties.description: Maximum remaining planar distance accepted as reaching a goal; nonnegative.

properties.name: heading_tolerance_rad
properties.description: Maximum absolute heading error accepted as aligned; nonnegative.

properties.name: realign_heading_rad
properties.description: Absolute heading error at which forward travel stops for realignment; no smaller than heading_tolerance_rad.

exceptions: TypeError if an argument is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a number is not finite or violates the range stated above, approach_speed_mm_s exceeds cruise_speed_mm_s, or realign_heading_rad is below heading_tolerance_rad.

sections.title: Live controls and telemetry values
sections.introduction: Import ucsb_xrp.live to create compact controls and publish selected program values to the Monitor. Declare controls once, then read each LiveParameter.value during the robot loop. Robot applies all pending control changes together after each Robot.start() or Robot.step() call.

entries.name: ucsb_xrp.live
entries.purpose: Create Monitor controls and publish selected program values.
entries.state: Retain declared controls and the latest watch and plot values for the current run. Robot applies all pending control changes together after each Robot.start() or Robot.step() call.

entries.name: LiveParameter
entries.purpose: Represent one Monitor control and the value currently applied to the program.
entries.state: The value changes only when live.apply_updates(), Robot.start(), or Robot.step() applies a pending Monitor setting.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Value currently applied to the program; read it but do not assign to it.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Python-style identifier.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Short Monitor label.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: number, toggle, or choice.

properties.name: unit
properties.description: Displayed unit or empty string.

properties.name: minimum
properties.description: Numeric slider lower bound.

properties.name: maximum
properties.description: Numeric slider upper bound.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Numeric slider increment.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Choice values, or an empty tuple.

entries.name: live.number
entries.purpose: Declare a bounded numeric slider.
entries.signature: live.number(name, default, minimum, maximum, step, unit='', label=None) -> LiveParameter

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique Python-style identifier, at most 32 characters.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

requiredBehavior: maximum must exceed minimum; step must be positive and no larger than the range; default must lie inside the inclusive bounds.
The range does not need to contain an exact whole number of steps. The applied value is the nearest available step within the bounds.
exceptions: TypeError if name, unit, or label is not a string or a numeric argument is Boolean or nonnumeric.

ValueError if text is empty or too long, name is not a Python identifier, a number is nonfinite, bounds or step are invalid, default lies outside the bounds, the name is already in use, or 16 controls already exist.

entries.name: live.toggle
entries.purpose: Declare an on/off control.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

exceptions: TypeError if name or label is not a string or default is not Boolean.
ValueError if text is empty or too long, name is not a Python identifier, the name is already in use, or 16 controls already exist.

entries.name: live.choice
entries.purpose: Declare a control with two to six string choices.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Initial applied choice; it must appear in options.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

exceptions: TypeError if name, label, or any choice is not a string.

ValueError if text is empty or too long, name is not a Python identifier, options does not contain two to six unique choices, default is not one of them, the name is already in use, or 16 controls already exist.

entries.name: live.watch
entries.purpose: Publish the latest number, Boolean, or short string as a named live value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Finite number, Boolean, or string of at most 64 characters.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

exceptions: TypeError if name, unit, or label is not a string or value is not a number, Boolean, or string.
ValueError if text is empty or too long, name is not a Python identifier, a numeric value is nonfinite, or 16 watch values already exist.

entries.name: live.plot
entries.purpose: Publish a finite numeric value as an optional Monitor strip-plot signal.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Finite numeric value for the current sample.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Displayed label; derived from name when omitted.

exceptions: TypeError if name, unit, or label is not a string or value is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if text is empty or too long, name is not a Python identifier, value is nonfinite, or 16 plot values already exist.

entries.name: live.apply_updates
entries.purpose: Apply all pending Monitor control changes together and report whether any applied value changed.

returns.description: True if at least one applied value changed.

notes: Robot.start() and Robot.step() call this automatically. Call it directly only in a program that does not use Robot.

entries.name: ProjectWorld
entries.purpose: Provide one named world loaded from the project's world.json file, including bounds, initial pose, fixed obstacles, changeable features, and waypoint markers.
entries.state: The loaded world does not change. arena_map() creates a new ArenaMap, and waypoint methods create NavigationGoal values from the stored markers.

properties.name: id
properties.description: World identifier.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Display name.

properties.name: bounds_mm
properties.description: World bounds.

properties.name: initial_pose
properties.description: Configured start pose.

properties.name: feature_names
properties.description: Named changeable obstacle features.

methods.name: arena_map
methods.summary: Build an arena map with selected features blocked.

parameters.name: blocked_features
parameters.description: Feature names that should act as obstacles.

returns.description: Arena geometry with the named features marked as obstacles.

exceptions: ValueError if blocked_features contains a name not present in feature_names.

methods.name: waypoint
methods.summary: Return one named waypoint.
exceptions: ValueError if no waypoint has that name or its stored coordinates are invalid.

methods.name: waypoints
methods.summary: Return all waypoints in file order.

entries.name: load_world
entries.purpose: Load the default or named world from a project JSON file.
exceptions: OSError if path cannot be opened.
ValueError if the JSON, world list, selected world, bounds, coordinates, or names are invalid.
TypeError if a world field has the wrong JSON type.

entries.name: Rectangle
entries.purpose: Represent a closed axis-aligned rectangle in world millimeters.

properties.name: minimum_x_mm
properties.description: Minimum x boundary.

properties.name: minimum_y_mm
properties.description: Minimum y boundary.

properties.name: maximum_x_mm
properties.description: Maximum x boundary; greater than minimum_x_mm.

properties.name: maximum_y_mm
properties.description: Maximum y boundary; greater than minimum_y_mm.

properties.name: bounds_mm
properties.description: Minimum and maximum x and y bounds.

exceptions: TypeError if a boundary is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a boundary is nonfinite or the rectangle does not have positive width and height.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Test whether a point lies inside bounds expanded by margin_mm.
exceptions: TypeError if a coordinate or margin is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate is nonfinite or margin_mm is nonfinite or negative.

entries.name: ArenaMap
entries.purpose: Represent rectangular arena bounds, fixed obstacles, and named changeable obstacle features.
entries.state: The map does not change after construction. with_feature_blocked() returns a new ArenaMap rather than modifying the current map.

parameters.name: bounds_mm
parameters.description: Arena bounds as a Rectangle or four-number bounds.

parameters.name: blocked_features
parameters.description: Feature names initially treated as obstacles.

exceptions: TypeError if bounds or obstacles are not rectangles or four-number bounds, obstacles is not a sequence, features is not a dictionary of named rectangles, or a feature name is empty or nontext.
ValueError if a rectangle is invalid or blocked_features contains an unknown name.

properties.name: bounds_mm
properties.description: Arena bounds.

properties.name: obstacles
properties.description: Fixed obstacles.

properties.name: feature_names
properties.description: Named features.

properties.name: blocked_features
properties.description: Features currently treated as obstacles.

methods.name: feature_bounds
methods.signature: feature_bounds(name: str) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]
methods.summary: Return one feature's bounds.
exceptions: ValueError if name is not a known feature.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Test whether a point lies inside the arena.

returns.description: True inside or on the arena boundary.

exceptions: TypeError if a coordinate is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate is not finite.

methods.name: is_free
methods.summary: Test arena and obstacle clearance.

parameters.name: clearance_mm
parameters.description: Required nonnegative distance from walls and obstacles.

returns.description: True when the point satisfies the requested clearance.

exceptions: TypeError if a coordinate or clearance is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate is nonfinite or clearance_mm is nonfinite or negative.

methods.name: with_feature_blocked
methods.summary: Return a new map with one feature's blocked state changed.

parameters.name: blocked
parameters.description: Whether the feature should act as an obstacle.

exceptions: ValueError if name is not a known feature.
TypeError if blocked is not Boolean.

entries.name: OccupancyGrid
entries.purpose: Sample an ArenaMap into uniform free and blocked cells.
entries.state: Grid resolution, origin, dimensions, and blocked cells do not change after from_arena() creates the grid.
entries.signature: OccupancyGrid.from_arena(arena: ArenaMap, resolution_mm: float, clearance_mm: float = 0.0) -> OccupancyGrid
exceptions: TypeError if arena is not ArenaMap or a numeric argument is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if resolution_mm is nonfinite or not greater than zero, or clearance_mm is nonfinite or negative.

properties.name: resolution_mm
properties.description: Cell size.

properties.name: origin_x_mm
properties.description: Grid minimum x.

properties.name: origin_y_mm
properties.description: Grid minimum y.

properties.name: column_count
properties.description: Number of columns.

properties.name: row_count
properties.description: Number of rows.

methods.name: world_to_cell
methods.summary: Convert a world point to a cell or None outside the grid.

returns.description: Containing cell, or None outside the grid.

exceptions: TypeError if a coordinate is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate is not finite.

methods.name: cell_center
methods.summary: Return a cell center in world millimeters.

returns.description: World x and y coordinates in millimeters.

exceptions: TypeError if cell is not GridCell.
ValueError if cell lies outside the grid.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Test whether a cell is inside the grid.

returns.description: True when row and column are in bounds.

exceptions: TypeError if cell is not GridCell.

methods.name: is_blocked
methods.summary: Report blocked state; cells outside the grid are blocked.
exceptions: TypeError if cell is not GridCell.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.summary: Return free cells sharing a horizontal or vertical edge.

returns.description: Free edge-adjacent cells in deterministic order.

exceptions: TypeError if cell is not GridCell.

notes: For direct software tests, the full constructor accepts resolution_mm, origin_x_mm, origin_y_mm, column_count, row_count, and row-major blocked values. Course projects normally use from_arena().

entries.name: DeliveryTask
entries.purpose: Store the fixed values needed for one supplied delivery mission.
entries.signature: DeliveryTask(initial_pose, arena, grid_resolution_mm, clearance_mm, destination, observed_feature_name, range_sample_count, minimum_usable_range_count, blocked_range_threshold_mm, assume_blocked_without_range)

properties.name: initial_pose
properties.description: Robot pose at mission start.

properties.name: arena
properties.description: Arena before the observed feature is classified.

properties.name: grid_resolution_mm
properties.description: Positive occupancy-grid cell size.

properties.name: clearance_mm
properties.description: Nonnegative planning clearance.

properties.name: destination
properties.description: Delivery destination and optional final heading.

properties.name: observed_feature_name
properties.description: Arena feature classified by the range observation.

properties.name: range_sample_count
properties.description: Positive number of range samples to collect.

properties.name: minimum_usable_range_count
properties.description: Positive minimum usable readings, no greater than range_sample_count.

properties.name: blocked_range_threshold_mm
properties.description: Positive range at or below which the observed feature is treated as blocked.

properties.name: assume_blocked_without_range
properties.description: Blocked state used when no range estimate is available.

exceptions: TypeError if initial_pose, arena, destination, a numeric setting, or assume_blocked_without_range has the wrong type.
ValueError if observed_feature_name is unknown, a count is below one, minimum_usable_range_count exceeds range_sample_count, or a numeric setting is nonfinite or outside its stated range.

entries.name: DeliveryMission
entries.purpose: Perform range observation, map update, route planning, and navigation for a DeliveryTask.
entries.state: Retain task, the explicit optional navigation bound, the latest observation and route evidence, the executed navigation-step count, and result. result is None before run(), no_path when planning finds no route, step_limit when the explicit bound is reached, and delivered after navigation completes.
entries.signature: DeliveryMission(task: DeliveryTask, navigation: NavigationController, planner: GridPlanner, maximum_navigation_steps: int | None = None)

parameters.name: maximum_navigation_steps
parameters.description: Positive project-owned Robot.step bound, or None for no library-imposed bound. Moving course projects should pass a visible explicit bound.

exceptions: TypeError if task is not DeliveryTask, navigation and planner do not provide the required public methods, or maximum_navigation_steps has the wrong type.
ValueError if maximum_navigation_steps is below one.

properties.name: task
properties.description: Mission definition.

properties.name: maximum_navigation_steps
properties.description: Explicit navigation bound, if supplied.

properties.name: range_estimate_mm
properties.description: Latest combined stationary range observation. None means no usable estimate was available or run() has not yet reached the observation.

properties.name: feature_blocked
properties.description: Latest blocked/open classification for task.observed_feature_name, or None before classification.

properties.name: planned_path
properties.description: Latest route returned by the planner. None means no route was found or planning has not yet occurred.

properties.name: navigation_step_count
properties.description: Number of Robot.step navigation cycles executed by the latest run(), excluding stationary observation samples.

properties.name: result
properties.description: delivered, no_path, step_limit, or None before completion.

methods.name: run
methods.summary: Run the supplied delivery sequence and always attempt robot.stop().
exceptions: Exceptions raised by Robot, SensorModel, GridPlanner, NavigationController, or map construction. DeliveryMission always attempts robot.stop() before returning or re-raising. Reaching maximum_navigation_steps returns the last state with result set to step_limit rather than raising.

sections.title: Low-level XRP access and numerical functions

entries.name: XRPBot
entries.purpose: Read the XRP's encoders, clock, ultrasonic sensor, and USER button, and send bounded DriveCommand values to its motors. Ordinary course programs use Robot; use XRPBot directly only for low-level experiments.
entries.state: Retain the RobotConfig and the encoder counts chosen as zero by reset_encoders().

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Motor signs, encoder signs, and final command limit.

exceptions: TypeError if config is not a RobotConfig value.
Hardware exception if XRP devices cannot be initialized or stopped.

properties.name: config
properties.description: Hardware configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.summary: Read encoders, time, button state, and optionally range.

parameters.name: include_range
parameters.description: Read the ultrasonic sensor on this sample.

exceptions: TypeError if include_range is not Boolean.
Hardware or run-stop exception while reading the XRP.

methods.name: reset_encoders
methods.summary: Use current hardware counts as the session zero.
exceptions: Hardware or run-stop exception while reading encoder counts.

methods.name: wait_for_button
methods.summary: Wait for the XRP USER button.
exceptions: Hardware or run-stop exception while waiting.

methods.name: set_drive
methods.summary: Apply one normalized motor command after configured signs and limits.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Logical left and right motor commands.

exceptions: TypeError if command is not DriveCommand.
ValueError if a command field is not a finite real number.
Hardware or run-stop exception while writing the motors; XRPBot attempts to stop both motors before re-raising.

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Attempt to stop both motors.
exceptions: Hardware exception if either motor cannot be set to zero.

notes: set_efforts() is a compatibility alias for set_drive().

entries.name: clamp
entries.purpose: Limit a numeric value to an inclusive interval.

parameters.name: upper
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound; not less than lower.

returns.description: The input value limited to [lower, upper].

exceptions: TypeError if an argument is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if an argument is not finite or lower exceeds upper.

entries.name: elapsed_time_s
entries.purpose: Calculate a MicroPython-tick-safe elapsed interval in seconds.
exceptions: TypeError if either timestamp is Boolean or not an integer.

entries.name: wrap_angle_rad
entries.purpose: Return the equivalent angle in [-pi, pi).
exceptions: TypeError if angle_rad is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if angle_rad is not finite.

entries.name: distance_to_goal
entries.purpose: Calculate planar distance from a pose to a navigation goal in millimeters.
exceptions: AttributeError if pose or goal does not provide x_mm and y_mm.
TypeError if a coordinate is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate is not finite.

entries.name: bearing_to_goal
entries.purpose: Calculate wrapped world-frame bearing from a pose to a navigation goal.
exceptions: AttributeError if pose or goal does not provide x_mm and y_mm.
TypeError if a coordinate is Boolean or nonnumeric.
ValueError if a coordinate is not finite.
